in_sanskrit.name: Biplob
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Struggle, Fight, Courage
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Biplob एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Biplob is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'bi' meaning struggle or fight and 'plob' meaning courage. This name is associated with warriors, leaders, and those who face challenges with bravery and determination.
